content: Paneâŋa ilâ pa Maro Kindeni
Maro Kindeni, naneŋgu koipu ŋalae, naŋa ma atula noko kilala pwataki tu noko ŋa nde ŋalae ndo. Naŋa ma aporo kawâŋgu ndaŋge imâ pano mine ikura zo rârâni.
Ikura zo zo naŋa ma kawâŋgu ndaŋge imâ pano. Naŋa ma apaneano asuka noko ŋa kâki mine ku amo nâ.
Yova Kindeni i ŋa nde ŋalae ndo, aku ara ŋana kinda ma tapanea i ŋa tasuka kâki ndo. Ina âta tamwata, aku tamâta toŋge ikura tu isama i kilala sondo, ande tia.

O Yova Kindeni, kinzi tamâta kala simo lâ zo ŋine nde ma sitapâri panzi natunzi ŋana noko ne vetâŋa arara kâ, aku muli ŋga nenzi vâsa ŋinde kala ma sitapâri mine nâ pa warakanzi natunzi. Ikura zo rârâni, kinzi tamâta ma sipaneano mine nâ ŋana noko ne vetâŋa ŋalaŋala kâ.

Kinzi ma situla noko kilala pwataki tu noko ne walo nde kaika ndo, aku kumo pwai koipu ŋalae pa kelekele rârâni wa nia ndoni wa. Aku naŋa warakâŋgu kala ma kaloŋgu ŋgere mine nâ ŋana noko ne vetâŋa arara kâ.
Mao nâ, kinzi tamâta ma sitapâri ŋana mâsi kaika ŋalaŋala noko muŋga kuveta ŋinde, aku naŋa kala ma aporo atula noko kilala pwataki tu noko ŋa nde ŋalae ndo.
Kinzi ma siporo situla pwataki tu noko nde ara tamwata, aku ma siwâŋgi wâŋgiŋa ŋana noko ne wisi-wisi kâ mine tu,
“Yova Kindeni i nde kalo-sukâŋa warika wa wisi-wisi warika wa. I uru wisi nâna walele tia, aku ne tini-mwasa ŋalae ŋinde ikeno mine ku imo nâ.
Ina kala uru iveta kie ara nâ panzi tamâta rârâni, aku i uru io ne wisi-wisi ilâ pa kelekele rârâni muŋga ivetanzi sipâŋga ŋinde.”
Mao nâ, Yova Kindeni, kelekele vianzi kâ rârâni noko muŋga kupulianzi ŋinde nde ma sipanea noko ŋa sisuka kâki. Aku noko ne tamâta rârâni kala ma kawanzi ndaŋge pano.
Kinzi ma situla pwataki tu noko kumo koipu ŋalae kaika ndo pa samba wa tâno wa, aku ma sitapâri ŋana noko ne walo kaika ŋinde tona.
Mine kala tamâta rârâni ma sisama ŋana vetâŋa ŋalaŋala kie-kie noko muŋga kuveta ŋinde. Aku kinzi ma sisama tu noko kumo koipu ŋalae kaika tamwata, aku noko ŋa nde ŋalae ndo.

Mao nâ, noko ma kumo pwai maro mine ikura zo rârâni. Noko kumo koipu ŋalae, ma kumo mine ku kumo nâ. Yova Kindeni uru iveta ikura tamwata ne ŋgua pâŋa rârâni, aku i ne vetâŋa rârâni itula pwataki tu i nde wisi-wisi warika.
Tamâta ea sisânda malia kulu, ande i uru ivilanzi tamâta ŋinde rârâni. Aku ina uru ipu tini kaika panzi tamâta ea nenzi walo ŋalae koŋa tia.
Kinzi kelekele rârâni simo vianzi kâ ŋinde nde sio tininzi ŋana noko nâ tu ma kâpwa kusuanzi, aku noko uru kusuanzi lâ zo ndia putole ipunzi.
Nokoni uru kâpwa kulanzi kinzi rârâni taitu-taitu, kala sika lee kapwanzi pupuro lâ.
Mao nâ, Yova Kindeni ne vetâŋa rârâni nde sondo ndo, aku i ne vetâŋa rârâni itula pwataki tu i nde wisi-wisi warika.
Tamâta ea kinzi uru kalonzi tawana Yova Kindeni mao ku sisarâwa pa i tu ivilanzi, ande ipaloŋo pa nenzi noŋa rârâni.
Tamâta ea simege ŋana i kâ, ande i uru kelekele ndia ilonzi papa ŋinde ilanzi. I ipaloŋo pa nenzi noŋa, ku ikainzi piti lâ kazâŋa ilo.
Ina kala uru ikatonanzi tamâta rârâni ŋine ilonzi ndo ikeno pa i. Aŋga kinzi tamâta sakamao, ande i ma izavarunzi ndo lâ.

Mine nde naŋa ma apanea Yova Kindeni asuka i ŋa kâki ikura zo rârâni. Aŋga miki kelekele rârâni ŋine i muŋga ipuliami kala kapâŋga kamo viami, ande miki kala kapanea i kasuka i ŋa sapâŋa kâki mine ku kamo nâ.
